name: rsl-confluence
description: rsL Confluence Terminal — one web core, Tauri 2 desktop shell, Capacitor 8 mobile shell, PWA.
author: rsLozano

scripts.test: pnpm --filter @rsl/core-kit test && node --test packages/adapters/tauri/oauth.test.mjs packages/adapters/capacitor/oauth.test.mjs && node -e "const os=require('os'),p=require('path'),c=require('child_process');const o=p.join(os.tmpdir(),'oauth_loopback_test'+process.pid);const r=c.spawnSync('rustc',['--edition','2021','--test','apps/confluence/desktop/src-tauri/src/oauth_loopback.rs','-o',o],{stdio:'inherit'});if(r.status)process.exit(r.status);process.exit(c.spawnSync(o,{stdio:'inherit'}).status)" && pnpm --filter @rsl/confluence-web test && pnpm --filter @rsl/confluence-gateway test && pnpm --filter @rsl/confluence-recorder test && pnpm --filter @rsl/confluence-mcp test && node tools/fetch-binance-archive.test.mjs && node --test tools/check-acceptance-ids.test.mjs tools/check-certification-pr.test.mjs tools/no-org-ids.test.mjs tools/third-party-notices.test.mjs tools/licence-policy.test.mjs tools/check-egress.test.mjs tools/public-hosts.test.mjs tools/docs-parity.test.mjs tools/translation-review.test.mjs tools/order-paths.test.mjs tools/keyless-sources.test.mjs tools/backup-setup-doc.test.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings --test tools/publish-update.test.mjs tools/semver-stamp.test.mjs && node --test tools/native-icons.test.mjs tools/app-link-files.test.mjs && node tools/check-egress.mjs && pnpm run test:protect
